title: Registration Basics
body: Registration confirms eligibility and ties your ballot to correct districts. Use your current residential address and update promptly after moving.

title: Deadline and Method Variation
body: Registration timing differs by state and method (online, mail, in-person). Always confirm method-specific deadlines on the official state page.

title: Party Registration and Primary Access
body: Primary ballot access can depend on party registration under state law. Verify your party registration status before the state cutoff.

title: Verify Your Registration
body: After submitting a registration or update, re-check status before Election Day to confirm your record and assignment are active.
